headlines.headline: WARRIORS TURN COOL ON LEBRON PURSUIT AS FREE AGENCY DRAGS INTO AUGUST; EWING JOINS WIZARDS' BENCH
headlines.detail: LeBron James remains unsigned with training camps a month out as the Warriors no longer view themselves as the frontrunner; Jalen Duren's restricted free agency standoff with Detroit remains unresolved, and Patrick Ewing is joining the Wizards as an assistant coach.

headlines.headline: FALCONS PASS RUSHER JALON WALKER JR. CARTED OFF WITH APPARENT TORN ACL AS TRAINING CAMP INJURIES MOUNT LEAGUEWIDE
headlines.detail: Atlanta's second-year edge rusher was carted off the practice field Wednesday with a leg injury early reports indicate may be a torn ACL, adding to a wave of camp injuries as all 32 teams push into padded practices.

headlines.headline: THE 2026 COLLEGE FOOTBALL SEASON OFFICIALLY OPENS AS FBS PROGRAMS BEGIN FALL CAMP NATIONWIDE
headlines.detail: FBS teams kicked off fall camp Wednesday, with Indiana's Stephen Daley returning for a fifth season and Boston College opening camp behind transfer QB Mason McKenzie; the season crowns its champion Jan. 25 in Las Vegas.

headlines.headline: NO. 1 2028 PROSPECT AJ WILLIAMS RECLASSIFIES TO 2027 AS SENATE ADVANCES PROTECT COLLEGE SPORTS ACT
headlines.detail: Five-star guard AJ Williams is reclassifying to 2027 and weighing nine schools; Quinnipiac transfer Amarri Monroe committed to Syracuse, and the NCAA warned it will suspend coaches who roster ineligible players.
